text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not check the requirement to keep monthly churn below 4%.

- The price comparison itself held up moderately under the tested variations, but that does not establish compliance with the churn limit.
- Churn is currently modelled as a calculated outcome, not a measured value on the same scale as the “<4% per month” constraint, so the limit was excluded from the comparison.
- Results also rest partly on a default £0 starting value for Non‑Pro MRR, rather than a stated figure.

The key unresolved reasoning step is to define what measured churn figure the 4% limit should constrain.
